description: When suppliers are out-of-stock, the response should clearly state where the workflow stopped and why.
query: Need 500 units of X-2847-ALL-OOS for Paris under project PROJ-2026-45, budget 75000 EUR. Tell me exactly which stage blocks fulfillment.

evaluation.expected_response:
## Decision
Cannot fulfill now
## Purchase Orders
No PO created
## Next Steps
Backorder or retry plan
evaluation.criterion: Evaluate whether the system provides stage-level transparency (inventory -> supplier stop), avoids fabricated downstream approvals, and returns actionable fallback steps.
